messages.author: c64c855afdc4e377
messages.subject: Adding images to package folders
parts:
Hi,

I am using a JS package and per the library if I add new SVG images to one of the folders within the package, I should be able to use those images as icons in my app.  The functionality works fine when run locally but when deployed over shinyapps.io, I cannot reference those images.  The package comes with its own set of icons but the user can add new ones to it.  Over shinyapps.io, I can only reference the default icons/images.

Can you please let me when app is deployed onto shinyapps.io, does it install the R packages from cran/github or locally from the users system.  I suspect it is directly installing or referencing packages available over cvran/github rather than my system and hence it is not ale to reference the newly added SVG images


Appreciate some guidance.

Regards
SD

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Adding images to package folders
parts:
Include the assets in the bundle you upload to shinyapps.io and install them to the package when the app starts up.
Or coordinate with the package owner to fetch images from a custom location.
